title.zh: 量产闭环：可靠性必须从 Fab追到现场
title.en: Production loop: track reliability from fab to field

subtitle.zh: Inline / WAT / Qualification / Monitor / FA / Field
subtitle.en: Inline / WAT / Qualification / Monitor / FA / Field

body.zh: Inline / WAT / Qualification / Monitor / FA / Field
body.en: Inline / WAT / Qualification / Monitor / FA / Field

body.zh: 工艺优化、设计改进与验证
body.en: Process optimization, design improvement and validation

body.zh: 定位机制、围堵、根因与改进
body.en: Mechanism localization, containment, root cause and improvement

body.zh: 参数分布、尾部与晶圆图
body.en: Parameter distributions, tails and wafer maps

body.zh: 更多筛选可减少逃逸，但增加成本并可能产生过应力；
body.en: More screening reduces escapes but increases cost and may overstress devices;

body.zh: Guardband 过大也会伤害性能与良率。
body.en: excessive guardbands also hurt performance and yield.

body.zh: Release、变更和认证范围应遵循客户、行业与 Fab 质量体系。
body.en: Release, change and qualification scope must follow customer, industry and fab quality systems.

body.zh: 可靠性不是某一次测试，而是一条从制造到现场再回来的闭环。
body.en: Reliability is a closed loop from manufacturing to the field and back, beyond any single test.
